maria (Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands security segment — can we get clarity on SOC2 evidence for Private customers? Particularly KMS/BYOK, audit log export options, and retention windows. cc @emily (Security)

emily (Security): Short answers first: SOC2 Type II report targeted for Q3; we'll provide a per-customer evidence bundle that includes a controls mapping, configuration snapshots (KMS settings, VPC peering configs), and curated log extracts. For Private/Dedicated customers we can provide more direct/exportable artifacts.

jordan (Eng): To add: we collect node-level and control-plane audit events. Default retention is 90 days for hosted, but Private deployments can extend retention to 1 year or more if they opt into additional storage. We support push-based forwarding (syslog/HTTPS) and S3 export for heavy customers.

samir (Sales): Is BYOK available for hosted customers yet or only Dedicated/Private?

emily (Security): BYOK (customer-managed keys) is available for Dedicated and Private installs today. Hosted API: BYOK for hosted is on the roadmap but not GA — legal and HSM integration items remain. For Dedicated/Private we support KMS integrations and HSM-backed keys; key rotation is customer-controlled, we recommend an annual rotation window but support custom schedules.

kevin (Customer Success): Customer asked if evidence includes raw audit logs or only redacted versions.

emily (Security): Default is redacted/log-level extracts for the SOC2 evidence package. Full raw logs can be provided for Private deployments (customers have direct access) or for hosted customers under NDA/contract and with a defined data export request. We also offer a signed integrity manifest for exported log bundles.

maria (Product): Action items: @emily to publish an FAQ in the security docs with a table of what each deployment mode receives; @jordan to add an S3/syslog export example to the ops docs; @kevin to collect top-3 customer asks about retention and BYOK by EOW.

emily (Security): Will do — I'll post the FAQ link here once live. :thumbsup:

jordan (Eng): Prelim S3 export snippet (will move to docs):
```
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood-inference.internal/logs/export \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"dest":"s3://acme-redwood-logs","range":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z/2026-03-07T00:00:00Z"}'
```

kevin (Customer Success): also capturing a few customers who asked for 365-day retention and HSM-backed BYOK — passing to product/security.

infra-bot: deploy-log-forwarder v1.3 completed on private-cluster-3 :rocket:

maria (Product): Thanks all — please ping this thread when docs/FAQ snippets are live. I'll consolidate into the all-hands follow-up notes.

emily (Security): Posted draft FAQ: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/soc2-evidence-faq — feedback welcome. (will lock after review.)

samir (Sales): Thanks! I'll update the sales playbook language to be explicit about hosted vs dedicated/private BYOK and retention options. :white_check_mark:

maria (Product): Great. Close loop next sync.
